info.title: Namat API — local synthetic intake
info.description: First local-only shared API boundary. No private record reads, clinical approval, AI processing or external email calls are implemented. Request bodies contain fictional data only. API version (/v1), source questionnaire version and explicit questionnaireRevision are independent. No global authentication scheme is declared because this initial service has no private read operations. Future case/plan operations require managed identity and per-record authorization before implementation.

post.summary: Save a fictional questionnaire and a pending confirmation
post.description: Validates the accepted questionnaire revision, active question path, contact values and bounded report attachments. Commits the submission and pending confirmation atomically. Does not call an external email provider or AI service. Retries with the same body requestId and same normalized content return the original receipt; changed content returns 409. Each HTTP response has its own server trace in X-Request-Id. Request body limit: 4,000,000 bytes. The process admits at most 60 authorized POST attempts per fixed 60-second window and at most four submissions concurrently; these are local development limits, not a distributed production rate limiter. The URL must match exactly: trailing slashes and query strings return 404. A new submission starts with confirmationEmail pending. An idempotent replay reports the stored notification outcome and does not reset completed, failed or uncertain work. The local worker can mark an acknowledgement simulated; simulated is not a send, and accepted is not proof of delivery.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Required for submission/preflight. Exact configured loopback browser origin; Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site is rejected. Not authentication and not a record-access credential.

QuestionnaireNotes.description: Only the named optional detail boxes are permitted. The server checks applicability to the active answers.

name.description: Trimmed filename, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, with .pdf, .jpg/.jpeg or .png extension matching type. Runtime checks byte length and extension.

size.description: Decoded byte length. Combined decoded bytes across all reports must not exceed 2 MiB.

base64.description: Canonical base64, without a data URL prefix. Runtime validates decoded size and file structure.

version.description: Legacy questionnaire model identifier; separate from API version and questionnaire revision.

questionnaireRevision.description: Explicit immutable questionnaire revision. Only this revision is accepted in the first implementation.

email.description: Email address; surrounding whitespace is trimmed and the address is normalized to lowercase. Submit fictional/example contact details during local tests.

firstName.description: A nonblank name after trimming, at most 80 characters after trimming. Runtime enforces trimmed length.

reports.description: If bloodwork is yes, attach one to three reports; if no, use an empty array. At most 2 MiB decoded total.

confirmationEmail.description: A new saved submission returns pending. An idempotent replay reports the stored confirmation outcome: pending (queued/in progress), simulated (local worker only; no email sent), accepted (recorded provider acceptance, not delivery), failed, or unknown (uncertain outcome held for reconciliation). This local API never calls an email provider. Stored failed/unknown outcomes do not trigger automatic retry.

NotFound.description: The request URL does not exactly match an implemented route. Includes unknown private record paths, query strings and trailing slashes.

X-Request-Id.description: Server-generated UUIDv4 identifying this HTTP request. Separate from the submission body requestId used for idempotency.

x-response-policy.notes: Application responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store. Allowed-origin responses echo the exact origin, expose X-Request-Id and vary on Origin. Every HTTP Host must be localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1] with the actual listening port. Unknown or nonexact paths use HTTP 404 with ApiError code not_found. HEAD never has a response body. Invalid HTTP framing may be rejected by Node with an empty 400 before a trace or application error can be produced; disconnected/timed-out sockets need not yield a JSON response. CORS restrictions are not authentication.
